caption: The drawing depicts a young girl standing and facing forward, wearing a light blue bonnet adorned with ruffles and a bow under her chin. She has a pale complexion and dark hair visible at the sides of her face. Her outer garment is a grey textured coat with wide, solid blue trim and cuffs along the edges and sleeves. Underneath the coat, she wears a peach-colored dress that is pleated vertically at the bodice and features peach and blue horizontal stripes at the hem of the skirt. Around her waist is a purple sash tied at the side with the ribbon hanging down. She has blue stockings and light blue ankle boots, decorated with orange buttons and brown soles. The background is blank and off-white, and the signature "Romano" is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll - "Rose Bates"
